s: October 20, 2025 - The big bye week presents big buying opportunities. At the top of the list is Nacua, who missed Sunday's game against the Jaguars in London with an ankle injury. Had the game been played stateside, Nacua might have tried to play, but with the Rams having a bye this week, it made sense for him to stay home. Obviously, the offense was just fine with QB Matthew Stafford tossing five TD passes. But if someone in your league is desperate for a win, snagging the top WR in fantasy points per game is worth waiting a week to use him.
